# Analysis of Karma

> Vedic astrologer Jag Mallah offers authentic Kundli readings, marriage matching, dosha analysis & remedies. Book a personal Vedic astrology consultation today.

Jag Mallah is an independent Vedic astrologer and professional meditation guide based in Surrey, British Columbia, consulting worldwide over Zoom and WhatsApp in English, Hindi and Punjabi. He completed formal studies in Advanced Astrology, Tajika (Varshaphala and Prashna Shastra), Muhurta and Medical Astrology under his mentor Sh. Sharawan Jha, and researches the classical texts Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Phaladeepika, Tajika Neelakanthi, Bhrigu Nandi Nadi, the Jaimini Upadesa Sutras and Swarodaya Shastra, grounded in the six classical Darshanas and Pancha Mahabhuta elemental balance.

## How booking works

1. Book a time — Choose a time that works for you on my calendar.
2. Send your info — Send your exact birth details — date, time and location — so I can prepare your chart before we meet.
3. Send me questions — Share what you’d like to know, so I can be prepared to read your chart for you.
4. We connect — We hop on a live Zoom or WhatsApp call for your reading.

## Pricing

I have a very simple, honest approach to payment. I believe in karma. Because of this, I do not charge new clients if they are not satisfied with their consultation.

If you do not find value in the reading, you do not pay — please don’t leave bad karma behind. If you do like the reading and find it helpful, you pay for it so that you do not carry a karma debt with you. It is entirely based on trust and energetic exchange.

## Honesty, boundaries and privacy

I believe in being completely upfront with you about what astrology is.

What the astrologer can do:
- I can act as your guide.
- I can show you the possibilities of difficult times ahead, so you can be careful and prepared.
- I can show you what karma is good for you, and what practices to apply to your daily life.

What the astrologer cannot do:
- I cannot stop things from happening.
- I do not give medical advice.
- I absolutely cannot — and will not — predict exact dates of death or exact mishaps.

Privacy:
- Strictly confidential: Your birth details and everything we discuss stay between us — always.
- No public testimonials: I never publish client stories or reviews, however beautiful they may be.
- Trust before advertising: Earning your confidence will always come before promoting my practice.

Disclaimer: Astrology readings are provided for guidance, fun, and educational purposes only. My services do not replace professional medical, psychiatric, or legal advice.
